purpose: Execution collection; supplements do not silently become formal release cases.

excluded_sources.reason: External product benchmark, not requested in this three-version internal regression.
Historical panel selector, not an independent set of task prompts.

evidence_contract.decision: Judge supplied facts and proposed actions; absent tools or fixtures never prove execution.
evidence_contract.artifact: Require actual files, semantic mappings and available render evidence; report unavailable visual coverage separately.
evidence_contract.file_task: Require per-run isolated project, preserved relative paths, before/after contents plus hashes and execution receipts. Tool-call arguments alone are not successful tool results. Missing execution or readback evidence is unverified, not an inferred pass/fail. Negative-operation claims need complete trace/coverage, not silence in prose.
evidence_contract.multi_turn: One case per agent; reveal only the current turn; controller captures every checkpoint before continuing.
evidence_contract.policy_probe: Evaluate policy choice only; do not claim provider invocation, no-side-effect proof or integration success from prose.
evidence_contract.trigger_probe: Description-only routing prediction; no SKILL body; not proof of native host auto-loading.
evidence_contract.integration: Use declared real or injected executable fixture and receipts; never score a prose substitute. Report separately from model quality.

comparison_policy.historical_results: immutable; new inputs are a new measurement, not a revision of old scores
comparison_policy.reporting: stable, challenge, trigger proxy, supplements and integration separately; no unified quality score
comparison_policy.runtime: frozen before this collection; evaluations never load the live repository or private Memory
comparison_policy.duplicates: report exact prompt-plus-fixture duplicates; no implicit dropping or score substitution
comparison_policy.retries: inherit evaluation-policy.json; no retry of valid low-scoring answers; third attempt waits without a time cutoff
